raw_response:
I am 42 years old, been farming since I was small, never went to school. My man and me work this 8 mu, two of the older ones go to town for work. I grow wheat and maize together like everyone here, and some cotton on the side because my mother always kept cotton for the quilts and I can sell some too.

I don't read the bags good. The dealer in town tells me what to buy and I look at what my neighbors carry home. Last year wheat give me maybe 450 kg one mu, maize a bit more, cotton not so much but the price was okay. I do same this year, maybe little more fertilizer because the ground feel tired.

For wheat I put the big bag of compound before planting, then urea when it green up in spring. I water from the well two three times — before winter, at jointing, and when the head come out. My neighbor Wang sao say this year pests bad so I spray little more.

Maize come after wheat, hot time, I don't plough deep, just the small machine turn the top. I put urea twice, water two times if no rain. The hybrid seed from the dealer — everyone buy that one, red bag.

Cotton I keep small, maybe 1 mu, my own saved kind mixed with some new seed. Cotton eat a lot of worm so I spray many times, my back hurt from it but what can do.
